subject: Renewal pricing safety net & growth ladder - QuantumBridge
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantumbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantumbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal timeline + capacity uplift

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. QuantumBridge is close to sign-off but we need a clean commercial path to accommodate a planned product ramp. Key asks from procurement and execs:

- Capacity uplift: we expect a ~40% increase in inference consumption starting Jan. Need an uplift path and clear true-up mechanics.
- Price protection: would prefer a price hold at current effective rates for the first 3 months of the new term while we stabilize usage.
- Credits: ask if Redwood can provide a one-time onboarding credit or quarterly usage credit to offset migration costs.

Timeline: procurement wants final commercial terms and SOW by Nov 30 to process PO in early Dec.

I've attached the updated SOW we used in the call (QuantumBridge_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf). Can you outline a concrete pricing ladder and whether a 90-day price-hold is doable?

Best,
Liam
Head of Cloud Ops
QuantumBridge

Attachment: QuantumBridge_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantumbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline + capacity uplift

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear asks. Internal note: looped Marissa for pricing sign-off.

Summary of what we can propose today (initial commercial sketch):

- Capacity uplift mechanics: add a tiered commit ladder. If QuantumBridge increases committed usage by >=30% we can lock a stepped discounted rate for that higher tier, with a 60-day true-up window to reconcile actuals.
- Price hold: we can offer a 90-day price hold on the effective per-token rate for the renewed committed tier.
- One-time credit: provide a $25,000 migration/onboarding credit applied to first invoice OR distributed as quarterly credits over Q1.

We need to confirm two things internally before we send formal counters: 1) whether finance is comfortable with a $25k credit vs. a credits schedule, and 2) Ben to propose a final discount band for the uplift tier.

I've attached your usage report request (usage_report_q3.xlsx) so we can baseline the uplift.

If that's acceptable I can draft a short amendment and SOW addendum for legal to review; Marissa, can you take the lead on the SOW + DocuSign flow?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachment: usage_report_q3.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@quantumbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline + capacity uplift — proposed commercial terms

Liam / Soojin,

Thanks — here's a concrete commercial suggestion to close quickly, subject to Marissa/legal sign-off:

1) Commit uplift band: If QuantumBridge increases committed consumption by 35%+ relative to the renewed baseline, Redwood will apply a 20% discount to the incremental committed tokens for year 1 of the uplift. Base tier pricing remains unchanged.

2) Onboarding credit: $30,000 one-time credit applied to the first invoice after execution.

3) Price hold: 90-day price hold on the renewed committed tier rates (as Soojin suggested). If QuantumBridge requests an extension beyond 90 days, we can discuss a staged extension tied to a minimum commitment level.

4) SLA/Operational concession: waive the first-month overage fees during the initial ramp (one-time grace period).

If you prefer a larger upfront discount (e.g., 25% on uplift), we would need a longer minimum commitment (12 months at the uplifted level) or increased contract term.

Next steps: Marissa to prepare SOW v3 with the uplift ladder and DocuSign package. Liam — is procurement willing to accept the $30k onboarding credit + the 90-day hold if we can keep the 20% uplift discount without adding a longer minimum?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantumbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantumbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline + capacity uplift — proposed commercial terms

Ben / Soojin,

Appreciate the quick turn. A few counterpoints from our side after running numbers with procurement:

- Discount: we would push for 25% on the incremental committed band (instead of 20%) given the scale of uplift and our multi-year roadmap.
- Price hold: 180 days would be preferable so we have a longer stabilization window. Procurement is firm on the PO date (need final SOW and commercial terms by Nov 30).
- Onboarding credit: $30k is acceptable.

We can concede the longer minimum commitment ask if Redwood requires it to support a 25% uplift discount — what would Redwood consider (e.g., 12 months at uplifted band)?

I'll ask procurement to prepare a draft PO contingent on receiving SOW v3 and a DocuSign package that reflects the agreed uplift mechanics.

Regards,
Liam

Attachment: QuantumBridge_Request_Nov23.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantumbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing safety net & growth ladder - QuantumBridge — next steps

Thanks all — recap and action items so we can close by Nov 30: 

Agreed commercial framework (pending final approvals):
- Commit uplift: 35% uplift band trigger.
- Discount: Redwood to confirm whether 25% can be accommodated for the incremental band; Ben to confirm by end of day 11/25. If 25% is not approved, default to 20% with no additional minimum term.
- Price hold: 90-day hold confirmed. Request from customer for 180 days noted — Marissa to list staged extension options in SOW v3 (90 / 180) tied to commitment duration.
- Onboarding credit: $30,000 one-time credit applied to the first invoice.
- True-up: 60-day reconciliation window post uplift month.
- Overage waiver: first month of ramp waived for overages.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm final discount band (20% vs 25%) and finance OK on $30k credit by 11/25 EOD.
- Marissa: produce SOW v3 and DocuSign package reflecting both 90-day hold and optional 180-day extension lanes; include the usage baseline and onboarding credit. Target to send draft to Liam by 11/26.
- Liam/QuantumBridge: if procurement can issue a conditional PO, please share the draft so legal can align with payment terms. Procurement needs the commercial package by 11/30.

I will hold the renewal slot for Nov 30 in our legal queue pending Ben/Marissa confirmations. If everyone is aligned we can push the DocuSign link to your procurement inbox and complete execution before month-end.

Thanks — appreciate the collaborative approach.

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
